title: 小灣水壩~Xiaowan Dam
focus: 強震區高拱壩與岸坡耦合~High arch dam and abutment slopes in seismic terrain
summary: 小灣案例將高拱壩傳力與兩岸岩體變形放入同一分析脈絡，探討卸荷、地下水、溫度和地震慣性如何改變原先假設。另以季節調蓄、下游變流及密度分層連接水庫運轉，讓學員分辨結構極限、量測殘差與環境控制是不同層次的判斷。~The Xiaowan case combines high-arch load transfer with abutment deformation, examining how unloading, groundwater, temperature and seismic inertia alter assumptions. Seasonal storage, downstream flow changes and stratification connect the structure to operation. Learners distinguish structural limits, monitoring residuals and environmental controls as different levels of assessment rather than one interchangeable score.
history: 華能公開介紹記錄小灣六部機組合計四千二百兆瓦，於二〇一〇年八月全部建成投產，並將高邊坡、卸荷與溫控列為工程難題。課程保留這些可核對的背景，但不把三百米級描述當成精確壩高。教學中的彈簧、岩楔及水量模型只分離一項機制，沒有重建業主三維分析或地震輸入。監測文獻出版與教材覆核各自標示，避免把網站文章更新日期誤認為水電站投產日。~Huaneng records six Xiaowan units totaling 4200 MW, all operating in August 2010, and identifies slopes, excavation unloading and temperature control as engineering challenges. The course retains those documented facts without interpreting a three-hundred-metre class description as an exact height. Spring, rock-wedge and water-balance examples isolate mechanisms rather than reproduce the owner three-dimensional model or earthquake inputs. Reference publication and curriculum review are dated separately from commissioning and from website article updates.
example: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「開挖卸荷彈性回復」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「方向剛度與傳力」及「岩楔有效正向力」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain；第二組為 F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。~This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Elastic rebound after excavation, then compare the controlling variables in Directional stiffness and load transfer and Rock wedge effective normal force. The first calculation is dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain; the second is F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.

units.anchor: 開挖卸荷彈性回復~Elastic rebound after excavation
units.title: 開挖卸荷彈性回復~Elastic rebound after excavation
units.mechanism: 深谷壩肩開挖改變原先岩體應力，部分變形是彈性回復，部分可能來自節理張開或損傷。先以應力變化除彈性模數估計一維應變尺度，便於檢查量測大小；但岩體模數須與方向、尺度及卸載路徑相符，不能拿完整岩芯數值代表全部邊坡。 卸載曲線與初次載入曲線未必一致，回復應變應使用相符的路徑模數，才能保留不可逆變形的意義。~Abutment excavation changes the original rock stress, producing elastic rebound as well as possible joint opening or damage. Stress change divided by modulus provides a one-dimensional strain scale for checking observations. Rock-mass modulus must match direction, scale and unloading path rather than being replaced indiscriminately by an intact-core value. Unloading and first-loading curves need not coincide; rebound strain requires a path-appropriate modulus so that irreversible deformation remains distinguishable from elastic recovery.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain。模型邊界：一維線彈性卸載應變幅度，未含節理張開及塑性損傷。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain. Model boundary: one-dimensional linear elastic unloading strain magnitude, excluding joint opening and plastic damage.
units.verify: 將開挖步序、伸縮計與地表位移時間對齊，分辨每次卸荷後的即時反應與持續變形。若持續位移在停工後仍增長，應查節理水壓或漸進破壞，不以單次彈性模數任意擬合所有時段。~Align excavation stages with extensometer and surface-displacement records, separating immediate rebound from continuing movement. Growth during a pause calls for investigating joint pressure or progressive deformation rather than fitting every interval by arbitrarily changing one elastic modulus in the simple unloading model.
units.failure: 開挖擾動可能形成方向性鬆弛帶，若仍用開挖前模數會低估位移；測點支架受爆破振動鬆動也可能造成跳值，需用深部與地表量測互相確認。~Excavation can produce a directional loosened zone, making the pre-excavation modulus underpredict movement. Blast-induced loosening of a sensor mounting can also cause a jump, requiring comparison of deep and surface measurements before attributing it to rock response.
units.misconception: 完整岩芯彈性模數可直接代表整座岩坡~An intact-core modulus directly represents the entire rock slope.
units.practice: 將卸載模數減半重算應變，再把假想伸縮計長度換成位移，畫出即時彈性及持續變形兩種時間曲線並提出區分證據。~Halve unloading modulus and recompute strain, convert it to movement over an assumed extensometer length, and draw immediate elastic and continuing-deformation histories with observations that distinguish them.

units.anchor: 方向剛度與傳力~Directional stiffness and load transfer
units.title: 方向剛度與傳力~Directional stiffness and load transfer
units.mechanism: 高拱壩向岩體傳力時，節理方向會使不同方向的等效剛度不同。教材以一個受壓岩柱的軸向變形建立尺度，不將岩柱當成實際三維拱座。受力面積與傳力長度是模型假設，需要地質與位移場支持；方向性被忽略時，總變形可能吻合而局部反力錯誤。 等效面積代表模型傳力範圍而非任意外觀面積，需與荷載方向和觀察尺度一起定義，才可比較剛度。~Joint orientation gives an abutment different effective stiffness in different directions. An axially loaded rock prism establishes a deformation scale without representing the actual three-dimensional support. Loaded area and transfer length are assumptions requiring geological and displacement evidence. Ignoring anisotropy can match overall motion while assigning incorrect local reactions. Effective area represents the modeled load-transfer region, not an arbitrary visible surface; define it with load direction and observation scale before comparing stiffness estimates.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm。模型邊界：均質線彈性岩柱沿單一軸向受力，不含拱座三維剪切。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm. Model boundary: homogeneous linear elastic prism loaded along one axis, excluding three-dimensional abutment shear.
units.verify: 以不同方向的現地載重或波速資料辨認方向差，再用多點位移場檢查所選傳力長度。若一方向模型需要不合理模數才能擬合，應研究幾何及節理控制，而不是只調大有效面積壓低位移。~Use directional field loading or wave-speed observations to identify anisotropy, then check transfer length against a multipoint displacement field. If one direction needs an implausible modulus, investigate geometry and joint control rather than merely enlarging the effective area to suppress movement.
units.failure: 某組節理剪切滑動會破壞單軸連續體假設，使反力重新分配；單點位移不足以分辨整體平移與局部轉動，可能掩蓋拱座接觸條件改變。~Sliding on a joint set invalidates the continuous uniaxial model and redistributes reactions. One displacement point cannot distinguish translation from local rotation and may conceal a change in the contact conditions supporting the arch.
units.misconception: 拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度~Every abutment direction can use the same effective stiffness.
units.practice: 分別把模數與面積減半重算位移，說明相同數值結果可能對應不同物理原因，再設計三個測點以辨別變形方向及轉動。~Halve modulus and area in separate cases and recompute displacement. Explain why equal numerical results may have different physical causes, then place three sensors to distinguish directional deformation and rotation.

units.anchor: 岩楔有效正向力~Rock wedge effective normal force
units.title: 岩楔有效正向力~Rock wedge effective normal force
units.mechanism: 邊坡岩楔沿既有面滑動時，水壓會降低有效正向力而削弱摩擦抗力。教材把已解析到滑面的正向、切向及黏聚合力分開，避免把岩楔總重量直接當成正向力。真實三維岩楔可能沿兩個面共同運動，仍需節理方位與出口條件判斷運動學可行性。 若水壓大到使接觸面張開，摩擦抗力不能繼續按負有效正向力延伸，必須改變接觸狀態。~Water pressure reduces effective normal force on a potential rock-wedge sliding surface and weakens frictional resistance. Separate resolved normal force, driving shear and cohesive resultant rather than treating total weight as normal force. Real three-dimensional wedges may move along two planes and require orientation and daylighting checks before force balance is meaningful. If pressure opens the contact, friction cannot be extrapolated using a negative effective normal force; the model must change its contact state and load path.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=20 MN; U=4 MN; mu=0.65 (dimensionless); C=2 MN; Tdrive=9 MN; FS=(mu*(N-U)+C)/Tdrive=1.377777778。模型邊界：單一假想滑面且抗力參數固定，只是力比，不作安全核准。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=20 MN; U=4 MN; mu=0.65 (dimensionless); C=2 MN; Tdrive=9 MN; FS=(mu*(N-U)+C)/Tdrive=1.377777778. Model boundary: one assumed sliding plane with fixed resistance parameters; a force ratio, not safety approval.
units.verify: 用節理測繪確認滑面方向及出露，再把降雨、孔壓與位移對齊檢查水壓假說。將剪力與正向力的解析方向畫在自由體圖上，若計算抗力大但位移持續，應研究峰值強度是否已退化。~Confirm orientation and daylighting through joint mapping, then align rainfall, pressure and movement. Show resolved shear and normal directions on a free-body diagram. Continued movement despite a large calculated resistance requires investigating whether peak strength has already degraded or the assumed surface is incorrect.
units.failure: 排水失效會提高滑面水壓並降低摩擦，抗力未必隨總重量增加而等量增加；若使用峰值黏聚力描述已滑動面，會把殘餘強度問題隱藏在漂亮的力比中。~Drain failure raises plane pressure and reduces friction, so resistance does not necessarily increase in proportion to total weight. Using peak cohesion on an already displaced surface hides a residual-strength problem behind an apparently favorable force ratio.
units.misconception: 岩楔總重量可直接當作滑面有效正向力~Total wedge weight can directly be used as effective normal force on the sliding plane.
units.practice: 將水壓合力加倍並去除黏聚合力，分別計算抗滑力比，列出哪些情境需要殘餘強度試驗，以及如何確認假想滑面是否出露。~Double the water-pressure resultant and remove cohesion in separate cases. Calculate the force ratios, identify situations requiring residual-strength tests, and explain how to confirm that the assumed sliding plane daylights.

units.anchor: 降水位孔壓滯後~Pore pressure lag during drawdown
units.title: 降水位孔壓滯後~Pore pressure lag during drawdown
units.mechanism: 水庫下降後，岸坡內孔壓可能因排水速度有限而仍偏高，外部水體支撐卻已減少。單一指數模型用來表示一個假想鬆弛時間，幫助比較降水位速度與內部反應；裂隙多路徑及飽和帶移動可能產生多個時間尺度，不能把擬合常數當成土性常數。 鬆弛時間描述系統幾何與排水路徑的綜合反應，增設排水後需要重新識別，不能直接沿用處理前數值。~After reservoir drawdown, internal slope pressure may remain high because drainage is slow while external water support has already diminished. A single exponential illustrates an assumed relaxation time for comparing drawdown and response. Multiple fracture paths and moving saturation boundaries can produce several time scales, so a fitted constant is not a universal material property. Relaxation time combines geometry and drainage pathways; adding drains changes that system, so the parameter must be identified again rather than inherited unchanged from earlier conditions.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：h0=10 m; t=24 h; tau=24 h; hExcess=h0*exp(-t/tau)=3.678794412 m。模型邊界：線性單一鬆弛模型的超額水頭，不是完整暫態滲流解。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: h0=10 m; t=24 h; tau=24 h; hExcess=h0*exp(-t/tau)=3.678794412 m. Model boundary: excess head in a linear single-relaxation model, not a full transient seepage solution.
units.verify: 同步紀錄庫水位及不同深度孔壓，以水位階段性變化檢查延遲，並比較上升與下降路徑。若深淺測點時間常數不同，應保留分層或裂隙效應，不把所有訊號平均成一條假想同步曲線。~Record reservoir level and pore pressure at several depths, using staged changes to examine lag and comparing rising and falling paths. Different deep and shallow response times require retaining layering or fracture effects rather than averaging every signal into one artificial synchronous curve.
units.failure: 快速降水位可能在內部高孔壓尚未消散時移除外部支撐，使岸坡有效應力與受力條件不利；但測壓管堵塞也會假造長滯後，需先驗證儀器反應。~Rapid drawdown can remove external support before internal pressure dissipates, creating unfavorable effective-stress conditions. A blocked piezometer can imitate a long lag, so instrument response must be verified before attributing the entire delay to slope drainage.
units.misconception: 水庫水位下降時岸坡孔壓必定同步下降~Slope pore pressure always falls simultaneously with reservoir level.
units.practice: 以兩種鬆弛時間畫出一天內超額水頭衰減，與同一降水位曲線比較，指出何處可能出現最大內外水頭差及所需補測深度。~Plot one-day excess-head decay for two relaxation times and compare them with the same drawdown curve. Identify the possible maximum internal-external head difference and the additional depths that should be monitored.

units.anchor: 地震慣性力尺度~Seismic inertia force scale
units.title: 地震慣性力尺度~Seismic inertia force scale
units.mechanism: 地震加速度對質量產生慣性力，但高拱壩、岩體與水庫形成耦合振動，不能把整體都當成一個剛性質點。教材先算一個假想等效質量的慣性尺度，再辨認方向、模態及水體附加作用。靜力等效算值不含頻率內容與相位，不能代替動力分析。 等效質量須說明對應方向與模態參與程度，壩體總質量不一定等於單一反應模態可使用的有效質量。~Ground acceleration generates inertia, while a high arch, rock supports and reservoir form a coupled dynamic system rather than one rigid particle. Calculate inertia for one assumed equivalent mass, then identify direction, modes and hydrodynamic contributions. A static-equivalent number contains neither frequency content nor phase and cannot replace dynamic analysis. An equivalent mass needs a direction and modal participation definition; total structural mass is not automatically the effective mass appropriate for one response mode.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：m=120000000 kg; ah=0.15 (dimensionless); g=9.81 m/s2; F=m*ah*g/1e6=176.58 MN。模型邊界：ah為無因次重力加速度比例，假想單質量水平慣性尺度。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: m=120000000 kg; ah=0.15 (dimensionless); g=9.81 m/s2; F=m*ah*g/1e6=176.58 MN. Model boundary: ah is a dimensionless fraction of gravity; horizontal inertia scale for one assumed mass.
units.verify: 對照加速度計方向、時間同步與基線修正，並比較壩頂及基礎頻譜以觀察放大。若反應包含多個模態，應以分布質量及阻尼模型處理，不把峰值位移除以一個靜力直接反算全壩剛度。~Check accelerometer orientation, synchronization and baseline correction, comparing crest and foundation spectra for amplification. Multiple response modes require distributed mass and damping models; peak displacement divided into one static force does not reliably identify stiffness of the entire dam.
units.failure: 不同方向地震分量的峰值未必同時發生，任意相加可能扭曲載重組合；忽略庫水與基礎互制也會錯估頻率，表面上保守的力值不保證反應保守。~Peaks of different earthquake components need not coincide, so arbitrary addition distorts combinations. Omitting reservoir and foundation interaction can also misplace natural frequencies; an apparently conservative force does not guarantee conservative dynamic response.
units.misconception: 等效靜力較大就保證所有動力反應保守~A larger equivalent static force guarantees conservative dynamic response in every mode.
units.practice: 固定加速度比較兩個等效質量，並畫出兩種頻率不同但峰值相同的輸入波，說明為何慣性尺度相同仍可能產生不同位移反應。~Compare two equivalent masses at fixed acceleration, then draw inputs with equal peaks but different frequencies. Explain why an equal inertia scale can still produce different displacement responses in the coupled system.

units.anchor: 受約束溫升應力~Restrained heating stress
units.title: 受約束溫升應力~Restrained heating stress
units.mechanism: 混凝土升溫希望自由膨脹，若沿一方向完全受約束，就會產生與自由熱應變相反的機械應變。教材用彈性模數乘熱應變估算壓應力幅度，並明確限制為單軸完全約束。實際早齡期材料會徐變，接縫也可能開合，必須避免把理想上界直接當成現場應力。 完全約束的總應變為零，但自由熱應變與機械應變各自非零，這個分解是辨認應力符號的關鍵。~Heating concrete creates free thermal expansion; complete restraint along one direction requires an opposing mechanical strain. Modulus times thermal strain estimates the compressive stress magnitude under a uniaxial fully restrained assumption. Early-age creep and joint movement alter real stress, so this idealized bound is not a field stress measurement. Total strain is zero under complete restraint, while thermal and mechanical strains are individually nonzero; their decomposition is essential for assigning the correct stress sign.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=25000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigmaC=E*alpha*dT=3 MPa。模型邊界：單軸完全約束升溫的壓應力幅度，忽略徐變及彈性模數變化。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: E=25000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigmaC=E*alpha*dT=3 MPa. Model boundary: compressive stress magnitude for uniaxial fully restrained heating, excluding creep and modulus change.
units.verify: 以混凝土齡期試驗取得模數與熱膨脹係數，將埋入溫度和應變計讀值配對，並分離自由熱應變。若實測壓應變小於完全約束模型，應研究徐變與接縫釋放，不應直接認定感測器低估。~Obtain age-specific modulus and expansion coefficients, pair embedded temperature and strain readings, and separate free thermal strain. Lower measured compressive response than the fully restrained estimate calls for investigating creep and joint release rather than immediately assuming sensor under-reading.
units.failure: 把升溫壓應力的符號誤作拉應力會顛倒開裂判斷，而冷卻受約束可能產生拉應力；若未追蹤應力自由溫度，單看當前溫度也無法決定應力方向。~Reversing the sign of heating stress reverses the cracking interpretation, while restrained cooling can create tension. Without tracking the stress-free temperature, current temperature alone cannot determine whether the mechanical stress is tensile or compressive.
units.misconception: 混凝土目前溫度高就必定承受拉應力~Concrete at a high current temperature must be in thermal tension.
units.practice: 以同一參考溫度計算升溫與降溫兩個情境，標示應力符號，再將約束比例改成一半，說明何種資料可支持這個部分約束假設。~Calculate heating and cooling from one stress-free reference, showing stress signs. Halve the restraint fraction and explain what displacement or connection evidence would support that partially restrained assumption.

units.anchor: 季節調蓄水量~Seasonal storage water balance
units.title: 季節調蓄水量~Seasonal storage water balance
units.mechanism: 季節性調蓄把豐水期來水延後使用，但可移轉水量受庫容、蒸發、環境流量與下游需求共同限制。教材先以平均入出流差積分一個月，建立可檢核的水量尺度；月平均不能描述月內洪峰，故仍要保留較短時段的操作與水位約束。 入出流平均值的採樣方法應一致，不等間隔觀測需要時間加權，否則算術平均可能偏向密集觀測的洪峰時段。~Seasonal regulation shifts water use from wet periods, subject to storage, evaporation, environmental releases and downstream demand. Integrate mean inflow minus outflow over one month as an auditable volume scale. A monthly average does not represent within-month flood peaks, so shorter-interval level and release constraints remain necessary. Inflow and outflow averaging must be consistent; irregular observations require time weights or an arithmetic mean can overrepresent flood peaks sampled more densely than other periods.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=1200 m3/s; Qout=900 m3/s; days=30; dS=(Qin-Qout)*days*86400=777600000 m3。模型邊界：固定月平均流量且忽略蒸發取水，未驗證可用庫容。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qin=1200 m3/s; Qout=900 m3/s; days=30; dS=(Qin-Qout)*days*86400=777600000 m3. Model boundary: constant monthly mean flows with evaporation and withdrawals omitted; available capacity is not verified.
units.verify: 將每日入出流與水位庫容變化比較，再核對月底帳本，保留日內最大水位而非只有月末值。若月總量閉合但日間頻繁超出假定空間，表示平均尺度掩蓋限制，需要重做逐時或逐日調度。~Compare daily flow balances with stage-storage changes and reconcile the month-end account, retaining maximum levels rather than only final values. A closing monthly total with repeated short-term space exceedances means averaging has hidden constraints and finer scheduling is required.
units.failure: 將月平均餘水全部當成可儲水量，會忽略洪水期間空間已滿的可能；水庫面積隨水位增加又使蒸發量變動，固定損失比例未必適合整季。~Treating all average surplus as storable ignores periods when flood storage is already full. Changing surface area also changes evaporation, so a fixed loss fraction may be inappropriate across an entire storage season.
units.misconception: 月底水量平衡就保證月內沒有庫容限制~A month-end water balance guarantees no capacity constraint within the month.
units.practice: 設計相同月總入流但不同洪峰集中度的兩條日曲線，逐日計算儲量，指出哪一條需要旁通放流，並比較其期末可用水量。~Construct two daily inflow sequences with equal monthly volume but different peak concentration. Calculate storage daily, identify which requires bypass release, and compare usable water remaining at the end of the month.

units.anchor: 梯級變流到達~Cascade release wave arrival
units.title: 梯級變流到達~Cascade release wave arrival
units.mechanism: 上游電站改變出流後，下游收到的是沿河傳播並被地形調制的水位流量波，不是整團水瞬間移動。教材用假定波速估算訊息到達時間，並區分波速與水粒子平均流速。分岔、回水與儲存會展寬波形，因此到達時間不能直接代表可用調節容量。 到達時間應區分波前、峰值與整體波形中心，三者在展寬河段可能不同，需先界定調度需要哪種時標。~An upstream release change reaches downstream as a wave modified by channel geometry rather than an instant movement of all water. An assumed wave celerity estimates signal travel time and is distinguished from average particle velocity. Branching, backwater and reach storage broaden the waveform, so arrival time is not regulating capacity. Arrival can mean the front, peak or center of a wave; these differ in a dispersive reach, so define the timing quantity relevant to coordination.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：L=80000 m; c=2 m/s; t=L/c/3600=11.11111111 h。模型邊界：固定波速的單一路徑估算，不含衰減及反射。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: L=80000 m; c=2 m/s; t=L/c/3600=11.11111111 h. Model boundary: single-path estimate with constant wave celerity, excluding attenuation and reflection.
units.verify: 用上下游同步水位與流量事件做互相關，並在不同基流下比較延遲與峰形。若高流量事件到達更快，應建立隨流況變化的傳播關係，不把一次事件的延遲當作所有調度命令的固定等待時間。~Cross-correlate synchronized upstream and downstream level-flow events and compare delay and shape at different base flows. Faster arrival at high discharge calls for a flow-dependent propagation relation rather than a fixed waiting period inferred from one event and applied to all dispatch changes.
units.failure: 把平均流速當波速可能錯配下游調度時機，忽略支流洪峰又可能讓波形疊加；若只看最高水位時間，會漏掉較早開始的流量變化。~Using mean particle velocity as celerity can mistime downstream coordination, while ignoring a tributary peak can miss superposition. Tracking only the highest level also overlooks the earlier onset of a release-related flow change.
units.misconception: 洪水波速必定等於水粒子的平均流速~A release-wave celerity always equals mean water-particle velocity.
units.practice: 對兩種波速計算到達時間，加入中途支流事件並畫出可能疊加區間，再提出測站位置以辨識傳播延遲與支流新增來水。~Calculate arrival times for two celerities, add a tributary event and mark possible overlap intervals. Place gauges that distinguish propagation delay from additional tributary inflow along the route.

units.anchor: 密度界面流態~Density interface flow regime
units.title: 密度界面流態~Density interface flow regime
units.mechanism: 水庫分層使界面恢復力取決於密度差而非完整重力加速度。密度福祿數比較流速與內部重力波尺度，可幫助判斷取水或入流對界面的擾動，但實際捲吸受剪切、混合及幾何控制。教材不把某個比值當成所有水庫通用的分層破壞界線。 密度差符號反映穩定或不穩定排列，若重水在上則原先穩定內波尺度不適用，需改研究翻轉混合。~Reservoir stratification gives an interface a restoring force based on density contrast rather than full gravity. A densimetric Froude number compares flow speed with an internal-wave scale and helps characterize disturbance, while entrainment depends on shear, mixing and geometry. No single ratio is treated as a universal interface-breakdown threshold. The density-contrast sign identifies stable or unstable layering; dense water above light water invalidates the stable internal-wave scale and calls for an overturning analysis.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777。模型邊界：雙層近似與已假定厚度尺度，未描述連續密度剖面。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777. Model boundary: two-layer approximation with an assumed thickness scale, not a continuous density profile.
units.verify: 量測溫度與必要的溶質資料以換算密度剖面，再配合流速垂向分布，確認所選厚度代表哪一水層。若界面模糊或存在多層，應改用更完整剖面分析，不把所有密度差集中在單一界面。~Measure temperature and relevant dissolved constituents to estimate density, paired with vertical velocity profiles. Define which layer the thickness represents. A diffuse or multilayer interface requires fuller profile analysis rather than concentrating the entire density contrast into one artificial surface.
units.failure: 僅以溫度推估密度而忽略含砂或溶質，可能把重流方向判錯；感測垂向間距過大則會漏掉薄界面，使內部波速與混合判斷失真。~Estimating density from temperature alone can miss sediment or dissolved-material effects and misidentify density-current direction. Coarse vertical sampling can also miss a thin interface and distort the inferred internal-wave speed and mixing interpretation.
units.misconception: 分層界面恢復力一律使用完整重力加速度~The restoring force at a stratified interface always uses full gravity without density contrast.
units.practice: 保持流速與厚度不變，把密度差減半重算比值，畫出兩種剖面並說明需增加哪些垂向測點，才能檢查雙層近似。~Halve density contrast at fixed speed and thickness and recalculate the ratio. Draw both profiles and identify additional vertical sampling points needed to test whether the two-layer approximation remains reasonable.

units.anchor: 岸坡位移速率~Abutment slope movement rate
units.title: 岸坡位移速率~Abutment slope movement rate
units.mechanism: 邊坡位移速率由相鄰觀測差除時間取得，必須保留方向與正負號。較短時間窗能顯示快速變化，卻也放大量測噪音；較長時間窗則可能掩蓋加速。課程先算平均速率，再要求與降雨、孔壓及施工事件配對，避免把一個斜率直接當成通用失穩預報。 速率差分的兩次位移若有共同基準誤差，部分偏差可能相消，但不同日期的基準跳動反而會放大假速率。~Movement rate is displacement change divided by elapsed time with direction and sign retained. Short windows reveal rapid change but amplify noise, while long windows can conceal acceleration. Calculate the mean rate, then compare rainfall, pressure and construction events rather than treating one slope of a time series as a universal instability forecast. A shared reference bias can partly cancel in displacement differencing, while a reference jump between dates can create a large false rate; distinguish the two errors.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：x1=12 mm; x2=17 mm; dt=8 day; v=(x2-x1)/dt=0.625 mm/day。模型邊界：單方向區間平均速率，不是警戒門檻或破壞時間預測。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: x1=12 mm; x2=17 mm; dt=8 day; v=(x2-x1)/dt=0.625 mm/day. Model boundary: single-direction interval mean rate, not an alarm threshold or failure-time prediction.
units.verify: 核對每次量測的基準穩定性與時間戳，將原始位移、速率及不確定度共同作圖。若速率增加只來自單次跳值，先查儀器；若多種獨立量測都持續加速，再研究水壓與岩體機制。~Check reference stability and timestamps, plotting displacement, rate and uncertainty together. An apparent increase caused by one jump calls for instrument checks. Sustained acceleration across independent measurements justifies investigating pore pressure and rock-mass mechanisms rather than relying on a single processed channel.
units.failure: 將長時間平均速率外推會漏掉近期加速，過度平滑也可能延後辨識；反之，差分噪音能製造假加速度，必須用原始位移及獨立測點支持解釋。~Extrapolating a long-term mean can miss recent acceleration, and heavy smoothing can delay recognition. Conversely, differencing noise creates false acceleration, requiring raw displacement and independent observation points to support the interpreted change.
units.misconception: 任何正位移速率都能直接推算破壞日期~Any positive movement rate can directly predict the date of failure.
units.practice: 用相同起訖位移製作等速與後期加速兩條曲線，比較八日平均及兩日速率，說明需要何種量測精度才可辨識其差異。~Create constant-rate and late-accelerating histories with identical endpoints. Compare eight-day and two-day rates and determine what measurement precision is required to distinguish the two movement patterns.
